definitions.explanation: The person who first established or created something, such as a company, organization, school of thought, or movement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創始者|そうししゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Who is the founder of the company?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創始者|そうししゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千年以上前|せんねんいじょうまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: The founder of this religion was born over a thousand years ago.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{武道|ぶどう}→武道：09640_budou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創始者|そうししゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{尊敬|そんけい}→尊敬：01454_sonkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He is respected around the world as the founder of that martial art.

notes:
Refers to the person who first brought something into existence. Unlike {設立者|せつりつしゃ} which focuses on the formal act of establishing an organization, {創始者|そうししゃ} emphasizes the creative or pioneering aspect of starting something new.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創始者|そうししゃ}: founder of a company
- ⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創始者|そうししゃ}: founder of a religion
- ⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創始者|そうししゃ}: founder of a school (of martial arts, art, etc.)
- ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創始者|そうししゃ}: originator of a movement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {設立者|せつりつしゃ}: focuses on the formal, institutional act of establishing something (a corporation, foundation)
- {開祖|かいそ}: founder of a religious sect or martial arts school; carries a more traditional, reverential tone
- ⟦{創業者|そうぎょうしゃ}→創業者：29027_sougyousha⟧: specifically a business founder who started a commercial enterprise
